description: Public Transport Accessibility Levels is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. Transport for London's (TFL) Public Transport Accessibility Levels (PTALs) PTALS are a detailed and accurate measure of the accessibility of a point to the public transport network, taking into account walk access time and service availability.
